title: CARLA: Adjusted common average referencing for cortico-cortical evoked potential data
description: Intracranial EEG (sEEG/ECoG) recordings from four patients undergoing single pulse electrical stimulation to elicit cortico-cortical evoked potentials. The dataset supports the development and evaluation of CARLA, an adjusted common average referencing method for cortico-cortical evoked potential data. It contains the raw data needed to reproduce the associated paper's results, except for figures 7 and 8, whose data are censored.
methods_description: Patients rested in a hospital bed while biphasic single pulse electrical stimulation was delivered at about 0.2 Hz, with a 200 microsecond pulse duration and 6 mA amplitude. Recordings were made at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN.
